exposure: Continuous infusion plus patient-controlled epidural analgesia (CI+PCEA)
Intermittent programmed epidural boluses plus patient-controlled epidural analgesia (PIEB+PCEA)
outcome: Delivery instrumentation (cesarean section, vacuum extraction, forceps, spontaneous vaginal delivery)
cohort: Patients admitted for labor at the University Hospital Nuestra Señora de Candelaria between January 2013 and December 2015.
finding: While there were no differences in the duration of labor stages or patient satisfaction, PIEB+PCEA was associated with a higher frequency of non-instrumented deliveries and less motor blockade compared to CI and CI+PCEA.
